MapsChangesInRainfallToControllerHaptics: Maps changes in rainfall to controller haptics.

EachCategoryIsAdjustable100IsTheCalibrat: Each category is adjustable. 100% is the calibrated default, 0% is mute, and the maximum is 200%. Changes take effect within one second.
